audience: operations and payroll managers who track clock-ins, timesheets and schedules in Timeero

useCases.title: See who is working now
useCases.text: List the users who are clocked in right now, with their job and location. Read the groups and jobs for context.

useCases.title: Review timesheets and breaks
useCases.text: List timesheets by user, group, job, approval status or date range. Open one timesheet for clock times, breaks and mileage.

useCases.title: Check GPS points of a timesheet
useCases.text: Read the GPS points recorded for one timesheet, next to its clock times.

useCases.title: Read the planned schedule
useCases.text: List planned shifts in a date range, filtered by job, employee or draft or published status. Open one schedule by id.

useCases.title: Clock users in or out
useCases.text: Start a timesheet for a user now or at a given time, or end the open timesheet. The records can be used for payroll.

useCases.title: Approve or unapprove timesheets
useCases.text: Approve timesheets by id, which locks the time for payroll. Remove the approval so the timesheets can be edited again.
